summary: Completed public API regression and desktop/mobile UI testing. Core marketplace flows pass, but authentication/session enforcement is absent on sensitive endpoints.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated POST returns 200 and reveals provider/needer contact details; payment is not secured by a session or verification state.
Returns the demo user to unauthenticated callers; verify-otp token is not enforced anywhere.
Accepts OTP 123456 for a non-institutional or mismatched email without validating the email or an issued OTP challenge.
allow_origins=['*'] is combined with allow_credentials=True, which does not provide an explicit credential-safe origin policy.

integration_issues.flow: Hire provider / resource rental / request submission / notifications
integration_issues.issue: notify() updates toast state, but App never renders the toast, so payment/contact reveal, request-created, upload, and notification confirmations are invisible to users.

action_items: Add session/token validation and authorization to /api/auth/me, /api/payments, transactions, requests, and verification flows.
Bind OTP verification to a validated institutional email and an issued challenge; enforce pending-student transaction policy as intended.
Replace wildcard credential CORS with explicit configured origins.
Render a visible, testable toast/status region for all notify() outcomes.
critical_code_review_comments: The returned loop-demo-session token is unused and all sensitive endpoints are public, so contact reveal and transaction mutation are forgeable.
Mutable module-level REQUESTS and TRANSACTIONS make state process-local and non-persistent across workers/restarts; this is unsuitable beyond the demo.
Frontend does not persist or attach the auth token after OTP verification.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ request and one mocked payment transaction during API/UI tests; data is process-local and not cleaned by an API endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome/auth, search, Priya hire, drone empty state, request modal/list, fx-991CW rental, profile pending/upload, insights, and desktop/mobile navigation were exercised. Re-run security expectations and verify visible success/error feedback after fixes.
rca of the issue: server.py returns a constant user and token from verify-otp but defines no auth dependency, cookie, or token middleware. payment(), me(), and verify_otp() therefore have no caller/session checks. In App.js, onDone stores only user state and notify() stores toast text without rendering it, hiding successful API outcomes.
